m: बाध् cl. 1. Ā. (Dhātup. ii, 4) बाधते, ep. and mc. also P. ˚ति (pf. बबाधे, RV.; aor. बाधिष्ट, ib., बाधिष्टाम्, TĀr.; fut. बाधिष्यते, ˚ति, MBh. &c., बाधिता Gr.; inf. बाधे, RV., बाधितुम्, MBh.; ind.p. बाधित्वा See s.v., बाध्य, RV.), to press, force, drive away, repel, remove, RV. &c. &c.; (with वरीयस्) to force asunder, RV. x, 113, 5; to harass, pain, trouble, grieve, vex, RV. &c. &c.; to resist, oppose, check, stop, prevent, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to set aside (as a rule), annul, invalidate, Pāṇ., Sch.; Nīlak. &c.; to suffer annoyance or oppression, TS. : Pass. बाध्यते, to be pressed &c.; to be acted upon, suffer, Pañcat. : Caus. बाधयति (aor. अबबाधत्, Pāṇ. vii, 4, 2), to oppress, harass, attack, trouble, vex, R.; Bhaṭṭ. : Desid. बिबाधिषते, to wish to remove or chase away, ĀpŚr., Sch.; बीभत्सते, to feel an aversion for, loathe, shrink from (abl.), Br.; ŚrS. &c. (cf. Pāṇ. iii, 1, 6) Intens. बाबधे (see प्र-√ बाध्); बद्बोधे, to press hard, hem in, confine, RV.; pr. p. बद्बधान, striking, knocking against (acc.), RV. vii, 69, 1 ; hemmed in, pent up, i, 52, 10 &c. [Cf. √ वध्, also for kindred words.]
a: बाध् — {c1c} A. (बाधते, बाधित) 1 To harass, oppress, torment, press hard, annoy, trouble, disturb, vex, pain (persons or things); ऊनं न सत्त्वेष्वधिको बबाधे R. 2. 14; न तथा बाधते स्कंधो यथा बाधति बाधते Subhāṣ.; Me. 53; Ms. 9. 226; 10. 129; Bk. 14. 45. --2 To resist, oppose, thwart, check, obstruct, arrest, interfere with; Ki. 1. 11; U. 5. 19. --3 To attack, assault, assail. --4 To wrong, violate. --5 To hurt, injure. --6 To drive away, repel, remove. --7 To suspend, set aside, annul, annihilate, abolish (as a rule &c.); R. 17. 57. --Caus. 1 To oppress, torment, harass &c. --2 To subdue, conquer. --WITH अभि {1} to hurt, injure. {2} to vex, harass, torment. --आ to vex, torment, injure. --परि to trouble, afflict; Ś. 7. 25. --सं to trouble, torment.

m: 1. बाध m. a harasser, tormentor, Hariv.
annoyance, molestation, affliction, obstacle, distress, pain, trouble, RV. &c. &c.

danger, jeopardy (see प्राण-)
exclusion from (comp.), Pañcat.
suspension, annulment (of a rule &c.), Sāh.; Pāṇ., Sch. &c.
a contradiction, objection, absurdity, the being excluded by superior proof (in log., one of the 5 forms of fallacious middle term), Kap.; Bhāṣāp. &c.
2. बाध m. (prob.) urging, impulse (Naigh. ii, 9 = बल, Sāy. = बाधक, बाधन), RV. vi, 11, 5; i, 61, 2; 132, 5 (?).
a: बाधः --धा — [बाध्-भावे घञ्] 1 Pain, suffering, affliction, torment; रजन्या सह जृंभते मदनबाधा V. 3. --2 Disturbance, molestation, annoyance; इति भ्रमरबाधां निरूपयति Ś. 1. --3 Harm, injury, damage, hurt; चरणस्य बाधा M. 4; Y. 2. 156. --4 Danger, peril. --5 Resistance, opposition. --6 An objection. --7 Contradiction, refutation. --8 Suspension, annulment. --9 A flaw in a syllogism, one of the five forms of हेत्वाभास or fallacious middle term; see बधित below. --10 Violation, infraction. --धा Refutation. --Comp. --अपवादः denial of an exception.

s: puM, (bA(vA)Date iti । bADa + Rvul .) strIrogaviSezaH । yaTA, -- “raktamAdrI taTA zazWI cANkuro jalakumArakaH । caturviDo bADakaH syAt strIRAM muniviBAzitaH ॥ tezAM svaBAvaM vakzyAmi yaTASAstraM viDAnataH । etezAM pUjanaM kAryyaM janEH santAnakANkziBiH ॥ niHsAraRaM sTApanaYca balidAnaM japastaTA । karttavyo guruvAkyena yaTASAstraM vicakzaREH ॥ caturviDo bADakastu jAyate ftukAlataH ॥” tasya lakzaRaM yaTA, -- “vyaTA kawyAM taTA nABeraDaH pArSve stane'pi ca । raktamAdrIpradozeRa jAyate PalahInatA ॥ mAsamekaM dbayaM vApi ftuyogo Bavedyadi । raktamAdrIpradozeRa PalahInA tadA Bavet ॥” iti raktamAdryAH ॥ “netre haste BavejjvAlA yonO cEva viSezataH । lAlAsaMyutaraktaYca zazWIbADakayogataH ॥ mAsEkena BavedyasyA ftusnAnadbayaM taTA । malinA raktayoniH syAt zazWIbADakayogataH ॥” iti zazWyAH ॥ “udbego gurutA dehe raktasrAvo Bavedbahu । nABeraDo Bavet SUlaM cANkuraH sa tu bADakaH ॥ ftuhInA caturmmAsaM trimAsaM vA Bavedyadi । kfSANgI karapAde ca jvAlA cANkurayogataH ॥” iti cANkurasya ॥ “saSUlA ca sagarBA ca SuzkadehAlparaktikA । jalakumArasya dozeRa jAyate PalahInatA ॥ yA kfSANgI Bavet sTUlA bahukAlaftustaTA । gurustanI svalparaktA jalakumArasya dUzaRAt ॥” iti jalakumArasya ॥ iti vEdyakam ॥ bADAjanake, tri ॥ (yaTA, mArkaRqeye । 34 । 16 । “Garmmo DarmmAnubanDArTo Darmmo nAtmArTabADakaH ॥”)
v: tri॰ bADa--Rvul । 1 pratibanDake । 2 strIRAmftukAle prajAjananaSaktipratiroGake rogaBede pu॰ । sa ca rogaScaturviDastallakzaRaM vEdyake uktaM yaTA “vyaTA kawyAM taTA nABeraDaH pArSve stane'pi ca । raktamAdrIpradozeRa jAyate PalahInatA । mAmamekaM dvayaM vApi ftuyogo Bavedyadi । raktamAdrI 1 pradozeRa PalahInA tadA Bavet । netre haste BavejjvAlA yonO cEva viSezataH । lAlAsaMyuktaraktaYca zazWI bADakayogataH । jAsEkena Baved yatra ftusnAnadvayaM taTA । malinA rakta yoniH syAt zazWIbADaka yogataH । udvego gurutAdehe raktasnAvo Baved bahuH । nABeraDo Bavet SUlaM cANkuraH 3 sa tu bADakaH । ftuhInA caturmAsaM trimAlaM vA Baved yadi । kfSANgI karapAde ca jvAlA cANkurayogataH । saSUlA ca sagarBA ca SuzkadehAlparaktikA । jalakumArasya 4 dozeRa jAyate PalahInatA । yA kfSANgI Bavet syUlA bahukAlasUtustaTA । gurustanI svalparaktA jalakumArasya dUzaRAt” vEdyakam ।

a: बाणः — 1 An arrow, shaft, reed; धनुष्यमोघं समधत्त बाणं Ku. 3. 66. --2 An aim or mark for arrows. --3 The feathered end of an arrow. --4 The udder of a cow. --5 A kind of plant (नीलझिंटी; f. also); विकचबाणदलावलयो ऽधिकं रुरुचिरे रुचिरेक्षणविभ्रमाः Śi. 6. 46. --6 N. of a demon, son of Bali; cf. उषा. --7 N. of a celebrated poet who lived at the court of king Harshavardhana and flourished in the first half of the seventh century; (see App. II). He is the author of कादंबरी, हर्षचरित and of some other works; (Govardhana in his Āryāsaptaśatī v. 37 speaks in these terms of Bāṇa: --जाता शिखंडिनी प्राग्यथा शिखंडी तथावगच्छामि . प्रागल्भ्यमधिकमाप्तुं वाणी बाणो बभूवोति ..; so हृदयवसतिः पंचबाणस्तु बाणः P. R. 1. 22). --8 A symbolical expression for the number ‘five’. --9 A sound, voice. --10 Fire. --11 Lightning. --णः, --णा The hinder part or feathered end of an arrow. --Comp. --असनं a bow. --आवलिः --ली f. {1} a series of arrows. {2} a series of five verses forming one sentence. --आश्रयः a quiver. --गंगा N. of a river said to have been produced by Rāvaṇa's arrow. --गोचरः the range of an arrow. --जालं a number of arrows. --जित् m. an epithet of Viṣṇu. --तूणः, --धिः a quiver. --पथः the range of an arrow. --पाणि a. armed with arrows. --पातः {1} an arrow-shot (as a measure of distance). {2} the range of an arrow. --मुक्ति f., --मोक्षणं discharging or shooting an arrow. --योजनं a quiver. --रेखा a long wound made by an arrow. --वारः a breast-plate, an armour, cuirass; cf. वारबाणः. --वृष्टिः f. a shower of arrows. --संधानं the fitting of an arrow to the bow-string. --सिद्धिः f. the hitting of a mark by an arrow. --सुता an epithet of Uṣā, daughter of Bāṇa; see उषा. --हन् m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.

बाण — The well-known author of the Harṣacarita, Kādambarī and Caṇḍikāśataka. Pārvatīpariṇaya and Ratnāvalī are also ascribed to him. His date is indisputably fixed by that of his patron Harshavardhana of Kānyakubja who was reigning during the whole of Hiouen Thsang's travels in India which lasted from 629 to 645 A. D. Bāṇa must, therefore, have lived in the latter half of the sixth or the first half of the seventh century. The date of Bāṇa is useful in ascertaining the dates-at least the termini ad quem --of several writers mentioned by him in his introduction to the Harṣa Carita.

kuzmARqAn brahmarAkzasAn । drAvayAmAsa tIkzRAgrEH SarEH SArNgaDanuScyutEH ॥ pfTagdivyAni prAyuNkta piRAkyastrARi SArNgiRe । pratyastrEH SamayAmAsa SArNgapARiravismitaH ॥ brahmAstrasya ca brahmAstraM vAyavyasya ca pArvvatam । Agneyasya ca pArjjanyaM nEjaM pASupatasya ca ॥ mohayitvATa giriSaM jfmBaRAstreRa jfmBitam । bARasya pftanAM SOrirjjaGAnAsigadezuBiH ॥ skandaH pradyumnabAROGErardyamAnaH samantataH । asfgvimuYcan gAtreByaH SiKinA prAdravadraRAt ॥ kumBARqaH kUpakarRaSca petaturmuzalArdditO । dudruvustadanIkAni hatanATAni sarvvaSaH ॥ vISIryyamARaM svabalaM dfzwvA bARo'tyamarzitaH । kfzRamaByadravat saMKye raTI hitvEva sAtyakim ॥ DanUMzyAkfzya yugapadbARaH paYcaSatAni vE । ekekasmin SarO dvO dvO sandaDe raRadurmmadaH ॥ tAni cicCeda BagavAn DanUMzi yugapadDariH । sAraTiM raTamaSvAMSca hatvA SaNKamapUrayat ॥ tanmAtA kowwavI nAma nagnA muktaSiroruhA । puro'vatasTe kfzRasya puttraprARarirakzayA ॥ tatastiryyaNmuKo nagnAmanirIkzan gadAgrajaH । bARaSca tAvadbiraTaSCinnaDabbAviSat puram ॥ vidrAvite BUtagaRe jvarastu triSirAstripAt । aByaDAvata dASArhaM dahanniva diSo daSa ॥ aTa nArAyaRo devastaM dfzwvA vyasfjat jvaram । mAheSvaro vEzRavaSca yuyuDAte jvarAvuBO ॥ mAheSvaraH samAkrandan vEzRavena balArdditaH । alabDvA Bayamanyatra BIto mAheSvaro jvaraH ॥ SaraRArTI hfzIkeSaM tuzwAva praRatAYjaliH ॥ jvara uvAca । namAmi tvAnantaSaktiM pareSaM sarvvAtmAnaM kevalaM jYaptimAtram । viSvotpattisTAnasaMroDahetuM yattadbrahma brahmaliNgaM praSAntam ॥ kAlo dEvaM karmma jIvaH svaBAvo dravyaM kzetraM prARa AtmA vikAraH । tatsaM GAto bIjarohapravAhastvanmAyEzA tannizeDaM prapadye ॥ nAnABAvErlIlayEvopapannErdevAn sADU~llokasetUn biBarzi । haMsyunmArgAn hiMsayA varttamAnAn janmEtatte BArahArAya BUmeH ॥ tapto'hante tejasA duHsahena SAntogreRAtyulvaRena jvareRa । tAvattApo dehinAM te'NGrimUlaM no severan yAvadASAnubadDAH ॥ SrIBagavAnuvAca । triSiraste prasanno'haM vyetu te majjvarAdBayam । yo nO smarati saMvAdaM tasya tvanno BavedBayam ॥ ityukto'cyutamAnamya gato mAheSvaro jvaraH । bARastu raTamArUQaH prAgAdyotsyan janArddanam ॥ tato bAhusahasreRa nAnAyuDaDaro nfpaH । mumoca paramakrudDo vARAMScakrAyuDe nfpa ! ॥ tasyAsyato'strARyasakfccakreRa kzuraneminA । cicCeda BagavAn bAhUMSCAKA iva vanaspateH ॥ bAhuzu cCidyamAnezu bARasya BagavAn BavaH । BaktAnukampyupavrajya cakrAyuDamaBAzata ॥ SrIrudra uvAca । tvaM hi brahma paraM jyotirgUQaM brahmaRi vANmaye । yaM paSyantyamalAtmAnamAkASamiva kevalam ॥ nABirnaBo'gnirmmuKamambureto dyOH SIrzamASAH SrutiraNGrirurvvI । candro mano yasya dfgarka AtmA ahaM samudro jaWaraM BujendraH ॥ romARi yasyOzaDayo'mbuvAhAH keSA viriYco DizaRA visargaH । prajApatirhfdayaM yasya DarmmaH sa vE BavAn puruzo lokakalpaH ॥ tavAvatAro'yamakuRWaDAman Darmmasya guptyE jagato BavAya । vayaYca sarvve BavatAnuBAvitA viBAvayAmo BuvanAni sapta ॥ tvameka AdyaH puruzo'dvitIyasturyyaH sadfgDeturaheturISaH । pratIyase'TApi yaTA vikAraM svamAyayA sarvvaguRaprasidDyE ॥ yaTEva sUryyaH pihitaH svacCAyayA CAyAYca rUpARi ca saYcakAsti । evaM guRenApihito guRAMstvamAtmapradIpo guRinaSca BUmana ॥ yanmAyAmohitaDiyaH puttradAragfhAdizu । unmajjanti nimajjanti prasaktA vfjinArRave ॥ devadattamimaM labDvA nflokamajitendriyaH । yo nAdriyeta tvatpAdO sa Socyo hyAtmavaYcakaH ॥ yastvAM visfjate martya AtmAnaM priyamI Svaram । viparyyayendriyArTArTaM vizamattyamftaM tyajet ॥ ahaM brahmATa bibuDA munayaScAmalASayAH । sarvvAtmanA prapannAstvAmAtmAnaM prezWamISvaram ॥ taM tvAM jagatsTityudayAntahetuM samaM praSAntaM suhfdAtmadEvam । ananyamekaM jagadAtmaketuM BavApavargAya BajAma devam ॥ ayaM mamezwo dayito'nuvarttI mayABayaM dattamamuzya deva ! । sampAdyatAM tadBavataH prasAdo yaTA hi te dEtyapatO prasAdaH ॥ SrIBagavAnuvAca । yadAtTa BagavaMstannaH karavAma priyantava । Bavato yadvyavasitaM tanme sADvanumoditam ॥ avaDyo'yaM mamApyeza vErocanasuto'suraH । prahrAdAya varo datto na vaDyo me tavAnvayaH ॥ darpopaSamanAyAsya prakfttA bAhavo mayA । sUditaYca balaM BUri yacca BArAyitaM BuvaH ॥ catvAro'sya BujAH SizwA BavizyatyajarAmaraH । pArzadamuKyo Bavato na kutaScidBayo'suraH ॥ iti labDvABayaM kfzRaM praRamya SirasAsuraH । prAdyumniM raTamAropya sa baDvA samupAnayat ॥ akzOhiRyA parivftaM suvAsaHsamalaNkftam । sapatnIkaM puraskftya yayO rudrAnumoditaH ॥ sa rAjaDAnIM samalaqkftAM DvajErmanoramErBUzitamArgacatvarAm । viveSa SaNKAnakadunduBisvanEraByudyataH pOrasuhfddvijAtiBiH ॥ ya etat kfzRavijayaM SaNkareRa ca saMyugam । saMsmaret prAtarutTAya na tasya syAt parAjayaH ॥” iti SrIBAgavate mahApurARe pAramahaMsyAM saMhitAyAM vEyAsikyAM daSamaskanDe bARAsurasaMgrAme SrIkfzRavijayastrizazwitamo'DyAyaH ॥

klI, (baRijo BAvaH karmma vA । baRij + zyaY .) vESyavfttiBedaH । ityamaraH ॥ baRijaH karmma BAvo vA । bARijyetyapi dfSyate । iti BarataH ॥ tatparyyAyaH । satyAnftam 2 bARijyA 3 baRikpaTaH 4 । iti jawADaraH ॥ (yaTA, mArkaRqeye । 51 । 54 । “kfzyAM bARijyalABe ca SAntiM kurvvantu me sadA ॥”) krayavikrayarUpasya tasya vivaraRAdi yaTA, -- “mAnena tulayA vApi yo'SamazwamakaM haret । daRqaM sa dApyo dviSataM vfdDO hAnO ca kalpitam ॥” yaH punarbaRik brIhikArpAsAdeH paRyasyAzwamamaMSaM kUwamAnena kUwatulayA vAnyaTApaharatyasO paRAnAM dviSataM daRqanIyaH । apahftasya punardravyasya vfdDO hAnO ca daRqasyApi vfdDihAnI kalpye ॥ “BezajasnehalavaRaganDaDAnyaguqAdizu । paRyezu prakzipan hInaM paRAn dApyastu zoqaSa ॥” mezajamOzaDadravyaM sneho GftAdiH ganDadravyamuSIrAdi AdiSabdAdDiNgumaricAdi । etezvasAradravyaM vikrayArTaM miSrayataH zoqaSapaRo daRqaH ॥ kiYca । “mfccarmmamaRisUtrAyaHkAzWavalkalavAsasAm । ajAtO jAtikaraRe vikreyAzwaguRo damaH ॥” na vidyate bahumUlyA jAtiryasmin mfccarmmAdike tadajAtiH tasmin jAtikaraRe vikrayArTaM ganDavarRarasAntarasaYcAraRena bahumUlyajAtIyasAdfSyasampAdane yaTA mallikAmodasaYcAraRena mfttikAyAM suganDAmalakamiti । mArjAracarmmaRi varRotkarzApAdanena vyAGracarmmeti sPawikamaRO varRAntarakaraRena padmarAga iti kArpAsike sUtre guRotkarzADAnena pawwasUtramiti kArzRAyase varRotkarzADAnena rajatamiti vilvakAzWe candanAmodasaYcAraRena candanamiti kakkole tvagAKyaM lavaNgamiti kArpAsike vAsasi guRotkarzADAnena kOSeyamiti vikreyasyApAditasya dfSyamfccarmmAdeH paRyasyAzwaguRo daRqo veditavyaH ॥ “samudgaparivarttaYca sAraBARqaYca kftrimam । ADAnaM vikrayaM vApi nayato daRqakalpanA ॥ Binne paRe tu paYcASat paRe tu Satamucyate । dvipaRe dbiSato daRqo mUlyavfdDO ca vfdDimAn ॥” mudgaM piDAnaM mudgena saha varttata iti samudgaM karaRqakam । parivarttanaM vyatyAsaH । yo'nyadeva muktAnAM pUrRaM karaRqakaM darSayitvA hastalAGavenAnyadeva sPawikAnAM pUrRakaraRqakaM samarpayati yaSca sAraM BARqaM kastUrikAdikaM kftrimaM kftvA vikrayamADiM vA nayati tasya daRqakalpanA vakzyamARA veditavyA । kftrimakastUrikAdermUlyaBUte paRe Binne nyUne nyUnapaRamUlyamiti । yAvattasmin kftrime vikrIyate paYcASatpaRo daRqaH paRamUlye punaH SataM dbipaRamUlye dbiSato daRqa ityevaM mUlyavfdDO daRqavfdDirunneyA ॥ * ॥ baRijaH pratyAha । “samBUya kurvvatAmarGaM sabADaNkAruSilpinAm । arGasya hrAsaM vfdDiM vA jAnatAM dama uttamaH ॥” rAjanirUpitArGasya hrAsaM vfdDiM vA jAnanto'pi baRijaH samBaya militvA kArURAM rajakAdInAM SilpinAM citrakarAdInAM sabADaM pIqAkaramarGAntaraM lABaloBAt kurvvantaH paRasahasaM daRqanIyAH ॥ * ॥ kiYca । “samBUya baRijAM paRyamanarGeRoparunDatAm । vikrIRatAM vA vihito daRqa uttamasAhasaH ॥” ye punarbaRijo militvA deSAntarAdAgataM paRyamanarGaRa hInamUlyena prArTayamAnA uparunDanti mahArGaRa vA vikrIRate tezAmuttamasAhaso vihito daRqyo manvAdiBiH ॥ * ॥ kena punararGeRa paRitavyamityAha । “rAjani sTApyate yo'rGaH pratyahaM tena vikrayaH । krayo vA nisravastasmAdbaRijAM lABakft smftaH ॥” rAjani sannihite sati yastenArGaH sTApyate nirUpyate tenArGeRa pratidinaM krayo vikrayo vA kAryyaH । nirgataH srazo nisravo'vaSezaH tasmAdrAjanirUpitAdyo nisravaH sa eva baRijAM lABakArI na punaH svacCandaparikalpitAt । manunA cArGyakaraRe viSezo darSitaH । “paYcarAtre paYcarAtre pakze mAse taTA gate । kurvvIta cEzAM pratyakzamarGasaMsTApanaM nfpa ! ॥” iti । kiYca । “svadeSapaRye ca SataM baRik gfhRIta paYcakam । daSakaM pAradeSye tu yaH sadyaH krayavikrayI ॥” svadeSaprAptapaRyaM gfhItvA yo vikrIRIte'sO paYcakaM SataM paRaSate paRapaYcakaM lABaM gfhRIyAt । paradeSaprApte punaH paRye SatapaRamflye daSapaRAn lABaM gfhRIyAt । yasya paRyagrahaRadivasa eva vikrayaH sampadyate । yaH punaH kAlAntare'pi vikrIRIte tasya kAlotkarzavaSAllABotkarzaH kalpyaH । evaYca yaTArGe nirUpite paRaSate paYcapaRo lABo Bavati taTEvArGe rAjYA svadeSapaRyavizaye sTApanIyaH ॥ * ॥ paradeSapaRye arGanirUpaRaprakAramAha । “paRyasyopari saMsTApya vyayaM paRyasamudBavam । arGo'nugrahakft kAryyaH kreturvikretureva ca ॥” deSAntarAdAgate paRye deSAntaragamanapratyAgamanaBARqagrahaRaSulkAdisTAnezu yAvAnupayukto'rTastAvantamarTaM parigaRayya paRyamUlyena saha melayitvA yaTA paRaSate daSapaRo lABaH sampadyate taTA kretfvikre troranugrahakAryyo'rGo rAjYA sTApanIyaH ॥ * ॥ prAsaNgikaM parisamApyADunA vikrIyAsampradAnamprakramate । tatsvarUpaM nAradenABihitam । “vikrIya paRyaM mUlyena kreturyanna pradIyate । vikrIyAsampradAnaM tadvivAdapadamucyate ॥” tatra vikreyadravyasya carAcaraBedena dbEviDyamaBiDAya punaH zaq viDatvaM tenEva pratyapAdi । “loke'smin dviviDaM paRyaM jaNgamaM sTAvaraM taTA । zaqviDastasya tu buDErdAnAdAnaviDiH smftaH ॥ gaRikaM tulimaM meyaM kriyayA rUpataH SriyA ॥” iti ॥ gaRikaM kramukaPalAdi । tulimaM kuNkumAdi । meyaM SAlyAdi । kriyayA vAhadohAdirUpayopalakzitamaSvamahizyAdi । rUpataH paRyANganAdi । SriyA dIptyA marakatapadmarAgAdi ॥ * ॥ ityetat zawprakAramapi paRyaM vikrIyAsaMprayacCato daRqamAha । “gfhItamUlyaM yaH paRyaM kreturnnEva prayacCati । sodayaM tasya dApyo'sO diglABaM vA digAgate ॥” gfhItaM mUlyaM yasya paRyasya vikretrA tadgfhItamUlyaM tadyadi vikretrA prArTayamAnAya svadeSabaRije kretre na samarpayati । tacca paRyaM yadi krayakAle bahumUlyaM sat kAlAntare'lpamUlyenEva laByate tadArGahrAsakfto ya udayo vfdDiH paRyasya sTAvarajaNgamAtmakasya tena sahitaM paRyaM vikretA kretre dApanIyaH । yadA mUlyahrAsakftaH paRyasyodayo nAsti kintu krayakAle yAvadeva yato mUlyasyeyatpaRyamiti pratipannaM tAvadeva tadA tat paRyamAdAya tasmin deSe vikrIRAnasya yo lABastenodayena sahitaM dvikaM trikamityAdi pratipAditavfdDirUpodayena vA sahitaM kretfvAYCAvaSAddApanIyaH ॥ * ॥ yaTAha nAradaH । “arGaScedavahIyeta sodayaM paRyamAvahet । sTAninAmeza niyamo diglABaM digvicAriRAm ॥” iti ॥ yadA tvarGamahattvena paRyasya nyUnaBAvastadA tasmin paRye vastragfhAdike ya upaBogaH tadAcCAdanasuKanivAsAdirUpo vikretustatsahitaM paRyamasO dApyaH । yaTAha nAradaH । “vikrIya paRyaM mUlyena yaH kreturna prayacCati । sTAvarasya kzayaM dApyo jaNgamasya kriyAPalam ॥” iti ॥ vikreturupaBogaH kzaya ucyate । kretuH sambanDitvena kzIyamARatvAnna punaH kuqyapAtaSasyaGAtAdirUpaH । tasya tu । “upahanyeta vA paRyaM dahyetApahriyeta vA । vikretureva so'narTo vikrIyAsaMprayacCataH ॥” ityanenoktatvAt । yadA tvasO kretA deSAntarAt paRyagrahaRArTamAgatastadA tat paRyamAdAya deSAntare vikrIRAnasya yo lABastena sahitaM paRyaM vikretA kretre dApayitavyaH । ayaYca krItapaRyasamarpaRaniyamo'nuSayABAve drazwavyaH । sati tvanuSaye krItvA vikrIya vA kiYcidityAdi manUktaM veditavyam ॥ * ॥ kiYca । “vikrItamapi vikreyaM pUrvvakretaryyagfhRati । hAniScet kretfdozeRa kretureva hi sA Bavet ॥” yadA punarjAtAnuSayaH kretA paRyaM na jiGfkzati tadA vikrItamapi paRyaM anyatra vikre yam । yadA punarvikretrA dIyamAnaM kretA na gfhRAti tacca paRyaM rAjadEvikenopahataM tadA kreturevAsO hAnirBavet । paRyAgrahaRarUpeRa kretfdozeRa nASitatvAt ॥ * ॥ api ca । “rAjadEvopaGAtena paRye dozamupAgate । hAnirvikreturevAsO yAcitasyAprayacCataH ॥” yadA punaH kretrA prArTyamAnamapi paRyaM vikretA na samarpayati ajAtAnuSayo'pi tacca rAjadEvikenopahataM Bavati tadAsO hAnirvikreturevAto'nyadaduzwaM paRyaM vinazwasadfkzaM kretre deyam ॥ kiYca । “anyahaste ca vikrItaM duzwaM vA duzwavadyadi । vikrIRIte damastatra mUlyAttu dviguRo Bavet ॥” yaH punarvinEvAnuSayamekasya haste vikrItaM puna ranyasya haste vikrIRIte sadozaM vA paRyaM prAcCAditadozaM vikrIRIte tadA tatpaRyamUlyAt dbiguRo damo veditavyaH । * । nAradenApyatra viSezo darSitaH । “anyahaste tu vikrIya yo'nyasmE tatprayacCati । dravyaM taddviguRaM dApyo vinayaM tAvadeva tu ॥ nirddozaM darSayitvA tu sadozaM yaH prayacCati । sa mUlyAddviguRaM dApyo vinayaM tAvadeva te ॥” iti ॥ sarvvaScAyaM viDirdattamUlye paRye drazwavyaH । adattamUlye punaH paRye vANmAtrakraye kretfvikretrorniyamakAriRaH samayAdfte pravfttO nivfttO vA na kaSciddozaH ॥ * ॥ yaTAha nAradaH । “dattamUlyasya paRyasya viDireza prakIrttitaH । adatte'nyatra samayAnna vikreturavikrayaH ॥” iti ॥ vikrayAnuSayo'BihitaH krItAnuSayasvarUpaM tu prAk prapaYcitamaDunA taduBayasADAraRaM DarmmamAha । “kzayaM vfdDiM ca baRijA paRyAnAmavijAnatA । krItvA nAnuSayaH kAryyaH kurvvan zaqBAgadaRqaBAk ॥” parIkzitakrItapaRyAnAM krayottarakAlaM krayakAlaparimARato'rGakftAM vfdDimapaSyatA kretrAnuSayo na kAryyaH । vikretrA ca mahArGanibanDanaM paRyakzayamapaSyatA nAnuSayitavyam । vfdDikzayaparijYAne punaH kretfvikretroranuSayo BavatIti vyatirekAduktamBavati । anuSayakAlAvaDiSca nAradenoktaH । “krItvA mUlyena yaH paRyaM duHkrItaM manyate krayI । vikretuH pratideyaM tat tasminnevAhnyavikzatam ॥ dDitIye'hni dadat kretA mUlyAttriMSAMSamAvahet । dviguRantu tftIye'hni parataH kretureva tat ॥” iti ॥ aparIkzitakrayavikraye punaH paRyavEguRyanibanDanAnuSayAvaDi daSEkapaYcasaptAhetyAdinA darSita eva । tadanayA vAco yuktyA vfdDikzayaparijYAnasyAnuSayakAraRatvamavagamyate । yaTA paRyaparIkzAviDibalAt paRyadozARAM ataH paRyadoze tadvfdDikzayakAraRatritayABAve'nuSayakAlAByantare'pi yadyanuSayaM karoti tadA paRyazaq BAgaM daRqanIyaH । anuSayakAraRasadBAve'pi anuSayakAlAtikrameRAnuSayaM kurvvato'pyayameva daRqaH । upaBogenAvinaSvarezu sTirArTezvanuSayakAlAtikrameRAnuSayaM kurvvato manUkto daRqo drazwavyaH । “pareRa tu daSAhasya na dadyAnnApi dApayet । AdadAno dadaccEva rAjYA daRqyaH SatAni zAw ॥” iti mitAkzarAyAM vikrIyAsampradAnaM nAma prakaraRam ॥ aTa bfhaspatiH । “kuzIdakfzibARijyaM prakurvvItAsvayaM kftam । ApatkAle svayaM kurvvan nEnasA lipyate dvijaH ॥ labDalABaH pitFn devAn brAhmaRAMScEva pUjayet । te tuzwAstasya taM dozaM Samayanti na saMSayaH ॥ baRik kuzIdI dadyAttu vastragokAYcanAdikam । baRik kuzIdyadozaH syAt brAhmaRAnAYca pUjanAt ॥” ityAhnikatattvam ॥

m: बाहु—सहस्र-भृत् m. ‘having a thousand a˚’, N. of Arjuna Kārtavīrya (killed by Paraśu-rāma), L.
बाहु—सहस्रिन् mfn. having a thousand a˚, MBh.; Hariv.; VP.

v: pu॰ bAhU brahmavAhU samBavo'sya । 1 bAhuje kzatriye hemaca॰ । 2 bohujAtamAtre tri॰ ।
m: बाहु—सम्भव m. ‘a˚-born’, a Kṣatriya, L. (cf. बाहु-ज).
बाहु—स्वस्तिक m. or n. ‘a˚-cross’, the arms crossed, MBh. (Nīlak.)
बाहु—ता (बाहु-), ind. in the arms, RV. (cf. देव-ता, पुरुष-ता).
बाहु—तरण n. crossing a river (with the a˚, i.e. by swimming), Gaut.

m: बाहु—त्राण n. ‘arm-fence’, armour for the arms, L.

m: बाहु—वार m. = बहु-व्˚, L.
बाहु—वीर्य mfn. strength of a˚, AV. &c. &c.
बाहु—वीर्य mfn. strong of a˚, TāṇḍBr.
बाहु—वर्तक mfn. (fr. बहु-वर्त), Pāṇ. iv, 2, 126, Sch. (Kāś. -गर्तक).
बाहु—वत् m. ‘having (strong) a˚’, N. of a man, VP.
बाहु—वृक्त m. N. of a descendant of Atri (author of RV. v, 71; 72), Anukr.
बाहु—विघट्टण or बाहु—विघट्टित, n. a partic. attitude in wrestling, VP.
बाहु—विद्ध m. patr. (fr. बहु-व्˚?), Pravar.
बाहु—विक्षेप m. moving the a˚, swimming, MBh.; Kathās.
बाहु—विमर्द m. = -युद्ध, Ragh.
बाहु—व्यायाम m. ‘arm-exercise’, gymnastic, MBh.
बाहु—योध or बाहु—योधिन्, m. a wrestler, boxer, Hariv.

s: klI, (bAhvo rbAhuByAM vA yudDam .) BujAByAM saMgrAmaH । mallayudDam । tatparyyAyaH । niyudDam 2 ॥ tasya kramo yaTA, -- “kftapratikftEScitrErbAhuBiSca sakaNkawEH । sannipAtAvaDUtESca pramATonmaTanEstaTA ॥ kzepaRErmuzwiBiScEva varAhodDUtanisvanEH । talErvajranipAtESca prasfzwABistaTEva ca ॥ SalAkAnaKapAtESca pAdodDUtESca dAruREH । jAnuBiScASmanirGozEH SiroBiScAvaGawwanEH ॥ tadyudDamaBavadGoramaSastraM bAhutejasA । balaprARena SUrARAM samAjotsavasanniDO ॥” iti virAwaparvvaRi 12 aDyAyaH ॥ sakaNkawaH kaNkawaH karaGarzaRajaH kiRastatsahitErityarTaH । kftapratikftEH paraprayuktipratikftEH । citrErvicitrErbanDEriti SezaH । sannipAtetyAdi । ete mallAnAM SikzAviSezAH । sannipAtEH parasparasaNGaGAtEH । avaDUtErbadDamuzwiBujAGAtEH । pramATEH pAtayitvA pezaREH । unmaTanEH antarIkze BujAByAM maTanEH । kzepaREH sTAnAt pracyAvanEH । badDANgulikaro muzwiH । “avANmuKaM skanDagataM BrAmayitvA taTEva yaH । kziptasya SabdaH sa BavedbarAhodDUtanisvanaH ॥ tarjanyaNguzWamaDyana prasAritakaro hi yaH । samprahArastalAKyastu saMgraho vajramizyate ॥” adDacandratulyamallamuzwirvajramityarTaH । “prasftANgulihastena prasfzwiH prahftiH smftA । dbiguRIkftabAhuryastadIyArTaM yaTAbalam ॥ prahAraH sa SalAkA syAt pAdodDUtaH padAhatam ॥” jAnuBiScASmaniGozEH pAzARaGorasadfSaDvaniBiH karaREryAnyavaGawwanAni tEH । balaprARena balotkarzeRa । iti tawwIkA ॥ (yaTA, mArkaRqeyapurARe । 83 । 13 । “tataH siMhaH samutpatya gajakumBAntarasTitaH । bAhuyudDena yuyuDe tenoccEstridaSAriRA ॥”)
v: na॰ 3 ta॰ । niyudDe amaraH । tatprakAraH BA॰ vi॰ 13 a॰ yaTA “kftapratikftEScitrErbAhuBiSca susaNkawEH । sannipAtAvaDUteSca pramATonmaTanEstaTA । kzepaRErmuzwiBicEva varAhodDUtaniHsvanEH । talErvajranipAtESca prasfzwABistaTEva ca । SalAkAnaKapAtESca pAdodDUtESca dAruREH । jAnuBiScASmanirGozEH SiroBiScAvaGawwanEH । tadyudDamaBavadGoramaSastraM bAhutejasA । balaprARena SUrARAM samAjotsava sanniDO । arAjata janaH sarvaH sotkruzwaninadotTitaH । balinoH saMyuge rAjan! vftravAsavayoriva । prakarzaRAkarzaRayoraByAkarzavikarzaREH । AkarzaturaTAnyonyaM jAnuBiScApi jaGnatuH” । mU॰ “kftaM kvaciddeSe nipIqanaM pratikftaM tasya SoDanam । susaNkawEH muzwigrahaRena kfSIkftEH sakaNkawEriti pAWe sakavacEH makiRErvA “kaNkawo bAhuvaraRe kavace kaWine kiRe” iti viSvaH sannipAto'NgasaMGawwanam abaDUtaM tenEva dUrIkaraRaM pramATAdaya uktA mallaSAstre “nipAtya pezaRaM BUmO pramATa iti kaTyate । yattUtTAyANgamaTanaM tadunmaTanamucyate । kzepaRaM kaTyate yattusTAnAt pracyAvanaM haWAt । uBayorBujayormuzwiruromaDye nipAtyate । muzwiricyate tajjYErgallavidyAviSAradEH । avANmuKaM skanDagataM BrAmayitvA taTEva yaH । kziptasya SabdaH sa BavedvarAhodDUtaniHsvanaH । talErvajranipAtErvajravaddfQapAtEScapezwEH । “aNgulyaH prasftAstAstu prasfzwA yA udIritAH । fjvI dfQA ruzA kziptaSAlakA sANgulI smftA” । tasyAnaKapAtEH pAdodDUtEH pAdaprasAraRenAkzepEH jAnuBiH SiroBiSca kftEravaGawwanErAsPAlanEH aSmanirGozErityuBayaviSezaRam । aSastraM nindyaM yaToktaM tatrEva “bAhuyudDaM hi BallAnAmaSastramfziBiH smftam । mftasya tatra na svargo yaSonihApi vidyate” iti । balaprARena balena SArIrabalena prARena mAnasabalena ca । sotkruzwaninadaH hIhISabdoccArARena KajjitasTa samutyApanam । tatsahitaH । “Akfzya kroqIkaraRaM prakarzaRamudAhftam । AkarzaRaM lIlayEva sanmuKIkaraRaM smftam । puraH paScAt pArSvayoScAByAkarzo BramaRaM taTA । paScAt prapAtanaM vegAdvikarzaRamudAhftam” nIlaka॰ ।
m: बाहु—युद्ध n. ‘a˚-fight’, a close fight, MBh.; Kathās.

k.v: समुदायः स्त्रियः संयत्समित्याजिसमिद्युधः। नियुद्धं बाहुयुद्धेऽथ तुमुलं रणसङ्कुले॥

m: बाह्व् in comp. for 1. बाहु.

m: बाह्व्—अङ्क m. the bend of the arm, ἀγκών AV.
बाह्वट m. N. of a poet, Cat.
बाह्वृच्य n. the sacred tradition of the Bahv-ṛcas, the Ṛg-veda, ŚāṅkhŚr. (cf. Pāṇ. iv, 3, 129).
a: बाह्वृच्यं — Traditional teaching of the Ṛgveda.

m: बाह्व्—ओजस् n. strength of arm, RV. viii, 82, 2
strong in a˚, viii, 20, 6 &c.
strong in the fore-legs (said of a horse), i, 35, 9.
बाह्या f. (scil. त्वच्) the outer bark of a tree, ŚBr.
बाह्याभ्यन्तर mfn. external and internal (as diseases), Suśr.
बाह्यांस mfn. holding the hands outside (not between) the knees, Gobh. (cf. बहिर्-जानु).
बाह्या-शकल m. a fragment from a tree's outer bark, ŚBr.
बाह्याश्व m. N. of a man, Hariv. (v.l. वाह्˚).
बाह्यालय m. the abode of out-castes i.e. the country of the Bāhīkas, MBh. (v.l. वाह्यनय).
बाह्यान्त m. the outer end or corner (of the eye), L.
बाह्यान्तर् ind. from without and within, Prab.
बाह्यार्थ m. an external meaning (cf. बाह्य अर्थ above), Madhus.
external objects or matter or reality
बाह्यार्थ—भङ्ग-निराकरण n. N. of wk.
बाह्यार्थ-वाद m. the doctrine that the ext˚ world has a real existence, Śaṃk.
बाह्यार्थ-वादिन् mfn. maintaining the reality of the ext˚ w˚, ib.
बाह्यात् ind. from without, Pañcat.
बाह्यायाम m. a partic. disease of the nerves, ib.

बाह्य mf(आ)n. (fr. बहिस्; in later language also written वाह्य, q.v.; m. nom. pl. बाह्ये, ŚBr.) being outside (a door, house, &c.), situated without (abl. or comp.), outer, exterior (acc. with √ कृ, to turn out, expel), AV. &c., &c.
not belonging to the family or country, strange, foreign, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
excluded from caste or the community, an out-caste, Mn.; MBh. &c.
diverging from, conflicting with, opposed to, having nothing to do with (abl. or comp.), ib.
(with अर्थ), meaning external to (i.e. not resulting from) the sounds or letters forming a word, Pāṇ. i, 1, 68, Sch.
बाह्य m. a corpse (for वाह्य?), Kāv.
N. of a man (pl. his family), Saṃskārak.
(pl.) N. of a people, VP.
बाह्य (ifc. f(आ). ) the outer part, exterior, Rājat.
बाह्य ibc. outside, without, out, ŚBr. &c. &c.
a: बाह्य — a. [बहिर्भवः ष्यञ् टिलोपः] 1 Outer, outward, external, exterior, being or situated without; विरहः किमिवानुतापयेद्वद बाह्यैर्विषयैर्विपश्चितं R. 8. 89; बाह्योद्यान Me. 7; Ku. 6. 46; बाह्यनामन् ‘the outer name’, i. e. the address or superscription written on the back of a letter; अदत्तबाह्यतामानं लेखं लेखयित्वा Mu. 1. --2 Foreign, strange; Pt. 1. --3 Excluded from, out of the pale of; जातास्तदूर्वोरुपमानबाह्याः Ku. 1. 36. --4 Expelled from society, outcast. --ह्यः 1 A stranger, foreigner; Pt. 1. 259; 5. 26. --2 One who is excommunicated, an outcast. --ह्यं, बाह्येन, बाह्ये ind. Outside, on the outside, externally.

m: बाह्य—द्रुति f. ‘external solution’, a process in the preparation of quicksilver, Sarvad.
बाह्य—कक्ष m. the outer side (of a house), Rājat.
बाह्य—कर्ण and बाह्य—कुण्ड, m. N. of two Nāgas, MBh.
बाह्य—करण n. an external organ of sense, MārkP.; Śaṃk.
बाह्यक-सृञ्जरी and बाह्यका, f. N. of Sṛñjarī and one of the two wives of Bhajamāna (an older sister of Upabāhyakā), Hariv.
बाह्य—लिङ्गिन् m. a heretic, L.
बाह्यम् ind. outside, without, out, ŚBr. &c. &c.
बाह्य—प्रकृति f. pl. the constituents of a foreign state exclusive of the king (cf. प्रकृति), Pañcat.
बाह्य—प्रयत्न m. (in gram.) the external effort in the production of articulate sounds, Pāṇ. i, 1, 9, Sch.
बाह्य—रत n. = -सम्भोग, Cat.
w.r. for -तर, Kathās.
बाह्य—सम्भोग m. ‘external coition’, (prob.) gratification of sexual passion outside the vulva, Cat.
बाह्य—स्पर्श m. contact with external objects, Bhag.; MārkP.
बाह्य—ता f.
बाह्य—तद्धित n. (in gram.) an external or secondary Taddhita suffix (added after another one), Pāṇ. vii, 3, 29, Sch.
बाह्य—तर mfn. being outside, outer, external, Śaṃk.
turned out (of caste or society), an out-caste, Mn. x, 30.
बाह्य—तस् ind. outside, externally, on the outside of (with gen. or abl.), VS. &c. &c.
बाह्य—तो-नर m. pl., ‘external men’, N. of a people, MārkP.
बाह्य—त्व n. the state of being outside, exclusion, deviation or divergence from (abl.), Hariv.; Rājat. &c.
बाह्य—वासिन् mfn. dwelling outside a village or town (said of Caṇḍilas), MBh.
बाह्य—वस्तु n. external wealth or riches, Kum.
बाह्ये ind. outside, without, out, ŚBr. &c. &c.
बाह्येन ind. outside, without, out, ŚBr. &c. &c.
बाह्येन्द्रिय n. an outer organ of sense, Vedāntas.
बाह्योपवन n. a grove situated outside (a town, पुर्याः), BhP.
बाज-बहादुर-चन्द्र m. N. of a son of Nīla-candra and patron of Anantadeva, Cat. (cf. बाहादुर).
बाकायन m. patr. fr. बक (also pl.), Saṃskārak. (cf. g. नडादि).
बाक n. (fr. बक) a multitude of cranes, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 37, Sch.
बाकरुका f. a kind of crane, L.

m: बाकुल mfn. relating to or coming from the Bakula tree, Suśr.
बाकुल n. the fruit of the Bakula tree, L.
a: बाकुलं — The fruit of the Bakula tree.

m: बाकुर m. (fr. बकुर), with दृति (perhaps) a kind of bag-pipe, RV. ix, 1, 8.
बाल् ind. onomat. an interjection imitating the sound of a falling body, AV.

s: strI, (bAlAH keSA iva padArTA vidyante yasyAH । bAla + arSa Adyac tatazwAp .) nArikelaH । haridrA । mallikABedaH । alaNkAraBedaH । meDyam । truwiH । strI । iti mudrANkitA medinI ॥ GftakumArI । hrIveram । iti SabdacandikA ॥ ambazWA । nIlaJiRwI । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ ekavarzavayaskA gOH । yaTA, -- “varzamAtrAtubAlA syAdatibAlA dvivArzikI .” iti prAyaScittatattvam ॥ zoqaSavarzoyA strI । sA grIzmaSaratkAle ca praSaMsanIyA harzadA ca । iti rAjavallaBaH ॥ (yaTA, ratimaYjaryyAm । “bAlA strI prARadA proktA taruRI prARahAriRI । prOQA karoti vfdDatvaM vfdDA maraRamAdiSet ॥” yaTA, meGadUte । 83 । “gAQotkaRWAM guruzu divasezvezu gacCatsu bAlAM jAtAM manye SiSiramaTitAM padminIM bAlyarUpAm ॥” kanyAmAtre'pi । yaTA, mArkaRqaye । 21 । 28 । “iyaYca mUrcCAmagat kAraRaM yat SfRuzva tat । tvayi prItimatI bAlA darSanAdeva mAnada ! ॥” paYcavarzA smftA bAlA । iti hArIte । 1 । 5 .) m: बाला (आ), f. a female child, girl, young woman (esp. one under 16 years), Mn.; MBh. &c.
a one year new cow, L.
small cardamoms, L.
Aloe Indica, L.
a kind of metre, L.
a partic. mystical prayer, Cat.
N. of the mother of Vālin and Su-grīva (said to have been formed by Prajā-pati out of some dust which had fallen into his eyes), R.
a: बाला — 1 A girl, a female child. --2 A young woman under sixteenyears of age. --3 A young woman (in general); जाने तपसो वीर्यं सा बाला परवतीति मे विदितं Ś. 3. 1; इयं बाला मां प्रत्यनवरतमिंदीवरदलप्रभाचोरं चक्षुः क्षिपति Bh. 3. 67; Me. 83. --4 A variety of jasmine. --5 The cocoa-nut. --6 The plant घृतकुमारी. --7 Small cardamoms. --8 Turmeric. --Comp. --हत्या female infanticide.

m: बालाभ्यास m. early application, study during childhood, MW.
बालाध्यापक m. a teacher of boys (-ता f.), Rājat.
बालाध्यापक—ता f.
बालाशोक m. a young Aśoka tree, Vikr.
बालाचार्य m. N. of a teacher, Cat.
बाला—दीक्षित m. N. of an author, Cat. (cf. बाल-द्˚).
बालादित्य m. the newly risen sun, morning sun, MBh.
N. of princes, Rājat.
बालादित्य—व्रत n. N. of wk.
बालाग्र n. (वाल्˚?) a dove-cot, Mṛcch. i, 50/51 (Sch.)
बालाह (or वाल्˚) m. N. of a mythical horse, Buddh.
बालाहक m. id., ib.
N. of a serpent-demon, Hariv.
युद्धे बलाहक-जम्बु-माले, ‘in the contest between Bālāhaka and Jambu-māla’, Nīlak.
बाला-हत्या f. the murdering of female children, MW.
बाला-कल्प m. N. of wk.
बाला-कवच m. n. N. of wk.

m: बाल mf(आ)n. (cf. वाल) young, childish, infantine, not full-grown or developed (of persons and things), GṛS.; Up.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
newly risen, early (as the sun or its rays), Ragh.
new or waxing (as the moon), ib.; Kum.
puerile, ignorant, simple, foolish, Mn.; Hariv.; Kāv.
pure (as an animal fit for sacrifice), L.
बाल m. a child, boy (esp. one under 5 years), Mn.; MBh. &c.
(in law) a minor (minors are classified as कुमार or boys under 5 years of age, शिशु under 8, पोगण्ड from the 5th to the end of the 9th or till the 16th year, and किशोर from the 10th to the 16th year)
a fool, simpleton, Mn.; Pañcat.
any young animal, L.
a colt, foal, L.
a five years old elephant, L.
Cyprinus Denticulatus or Rohita, L.
N. of a Rakṣas, VP.
of a prince, Rājat.
बाल n. Andropogon Muricatus, L.

a: बाल — a. 1 Young, infantine, not full-grown or developed (of persons or things); बालेन स्थविरेण वा Ms. 8. 70; बालाशोकमुपोढरागसुभगं भेदोन्मुखं तिष्ठति V. 2. 7; so बालमंदारवृक्षः Me. 75; R. 2. 45; 13. 24. --2 Newly risen, young (as the sun or its rays); R. 12. 100. --3 New, waxing (as the moon); पुषोष वृद्धिं हरिदश्वदीधितेरनुप्रवेशादिव बालचंद्रमाः R. 3. 22; Ku. 3. 29. --4 Puerile --5 Ignorant, unwise. --6 Pure (as an animal fit for sacrifice). --लः 1 A child, an infant; बालादपि सुभाषितं (ग्राह्यं); Ms. 2. 239. --2 A boy, youth, young person. --3 A minor (under 16 years of age); बाल आषोडशाद्वर्षात् Nārada. --4 A colt, foal. --5 A fool, simpleton; Pt. 4. 91. --6 (a) A tail. (b) An elephant's or a horse's tail. --7 Hair; Ku. 1. 48. --8 An elephant five years old. --9 A kind of perfume. --10 The cocoa-nut. --Comp. --अग्रं the point of a hair. --अध्यापकः a tutor of youths or children. --अपत्यं youthful progeny. --अभ्यासः study during childhood, early application (to study). --अरुण a. red like early dawn. --(णः) early dawn; morning sun. --अर्कः the newly-risen sun; R. 12. 100. --अवबोधः --धनं instruction of the young; Pt. 1. --अवस्थ a. juvenile, young; V. 5. 18. --अवस्था childhood. --अ तपः morning sunshine. --इंदुः the new or waxing moon; Ku. 3. 29. --इष्टः the jujube tree. --उपचारः, -चरणं (medical) treatment of children. --उपवीतं {1} a piece of cloth used to cover the privities. {2} the sacrificial cord. --कदली a young plantain tree. --कांडं the first book of the Rāmāyaṇa. --कुंदः, -दं a kind of young jasmine. --(दं) a young jasmine blossom; अलके बालकुंद नुविद्धं Me. 65. --कृमिः a louse. --कृष्णः Kṛṣṇa as a boy. --क्रीडनं a child's play or toy. --क्रीडनकं a child's toy. --(कः) {1} a ball. {2} an epithet of Śiva. --क्रीडा a child's play, childish or juvenile sport. --खिल्यः a class of divine person ages of the size of a thumb and produced from the creator's body and said to precede the sun's chariot (their number is said to be sixty thousand); cf. R. 15. 10. --गर्भिणी a cow with calf for the first time. --गोपालः ‘the youthful cowherd,’ an epithet of Kṛṣṇa, as the boycowherd. --ग्रहः any demon (or planetary influence) teasing or injuring children. --घ्नः a child-slayer, infanticide. --चंद्रः, --चंद्रमस् m. the young or waxing moon; Māl. 2. 10. --चरितं {1} juvenile sports. {2} early life or actions; U. 6. --चर्यः N. of Kārtikeya. --(र्या) the behaviour of a child. --ज a. produced from hair. --तनयः the Khadira tree. --तंत्रं midwifery. --तृणं young grass. --दलकः the Khadira. --धिः a hairy tail; Śi. 12. 73; Ki. 12. 47. --पत्रः, --पत्रकः the Khadira tree. --पाश्या {1} an ornament worn in the hair when parted. {2} a string of pearls binding or intertwining the braid of hair. --पुष्टिका, --पुष्टी, --पुष्पी a kind of jasmine. --बोधः {1} instructing the young {2} any work adapted to the capacities of the young or experienced. --भद्रकः a kind of poison. --भारः a large bushy tail; बाधेतोल्काक्षपितचमरीबालभारो दवाग्निः Me. 53. --भावः childhood, infancy. --भृत्यः a servant from childhood. --भैषज्यं a kind of collyrium. --भोज्यः pease. --मृगः a fawn. --मूलं a young radish. --मृणालः a tender filament or fibre (of a lotus.). --यज्ञोपवीतकं the sacred thread worn across the breast. --राजं lapis lazuli. --रोगः a child's disease. --लता a young creeper. R. 2. 10. --लीला child's play, juvenile pastime. --वत्सः {1} a young calf. {2} a pigeon. --वायजं lapis lazuli --वासस् n. a woollen garment. --वाह्यः a wild goat. --विधवा a child-widow. --वैधव्यं child-widowhood. --व्यजनं a chowrie or fly-flapper (usually made of the tail of the yāk or Bos Grunniens and used as one of the royal insignia); यस्यार्थयुक्तं गिरिराजशब्दं कुर्वंति बालव्यजनैश्चमर्यः Ku. 1. 13; R. 9. 66; 14. 11; 16. 33, 57. --सखि, m. a friend from childhood. --संध्या early twilight. --सात्म्यं milk. --सुहृद् m. a friend of one's youth. --सूर्यः, --सूर्यकः lapis lazuli. --हत्या infanticide. --हस्तः a hairy tail.

k.v: बालं ह्रीबेरबर्हिष्ठोदीच्यं केशाम्बुनाम च। कालानुसार्यवृद्धाश्मपुष्पशीतशिवानि तु॥
बालस्तु स्यान्माणवको वयस्थस्तरुणो युवा। प्रवयाः स्थविरो वृद्धो जीनो जीर्णो जरन्नपि॥
उत्तमाङ्गं शिरः शीर्षं मूर्धा ना मस्तकोऽस्त्रियाम्. चिकुरः कुन्तलो वालः कचः केशः शिरोरुहः॥
पृष्ठ्यः स्थौरी सितः कर्को रथ्यो वोढा रथस्य यः। बालः किशोरो वाम्यश्वा वडवा वाडवं गणे॥

मूर्खेऽर्भकेऽपि बालः स्याल्लोलश्चलसतृष्णयोः। कुलं गृहेऽपि तालाङ्के कुबेरे चैककुण्डलः॥ स्त्रीभावावज्ञयोर्हेला हेलिः सूर्ये रणे हिलिः। हालः स्यान्नृपतौ मद्ये शकलच्छदयोर्दलम्.। तूलिश्चित्रोपकरणशलाकातूलशय्ययोः। तुमुलं व्याकुले शब्दे शष्कुली कर्णपाल्यपि॥ दवदावौ वनारण्यवह्नी जन्महरौ भवौ।

v: pu॰ bAlo vAhyo yasya । ikkawe anaCAge hArA॰
m: बाल—वाह्य m. ‘ridden by children’, a y˚ goat, L.

klI, (bAlavAye vEduryyapraBave deSaviSeze jAyate iti । jan + qa .) vEdUryyam । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥ (vivftirviSezaScAsya vEdUryyaSabde jYeyaH ॥)

a: बालवः — The second of the eleven Karaṇas.

m: बाल—वनिता f. a young woman, Hit.
बाल—वत्स mf(आ)n. one whose child is still a boy, MBh.; R.
बाल—वत्स m. a young calf, Ragh.
‘child's favourite’, a dove, pigeon, W.
बाल—वृक्ष m. = -तरु, Ragh.
बाल—विनष्ट or बाल—विनष्˚टक, m. N. of a man, Kathās.
बाल—विनोदिनी f. N. of wk.
बाल—विवेकिनी f. N. of wk.
बाल—व्रत m. N. of the Buddhist saint Mañjuśrī, L.
बाल—व्याकरण n. ‘a child's gr˚’, N. of a grammar.

s: klI, (bAlasya camarIpucCasya vAlena vA nirmmitaM vyajanam .) cAmaram । tatparyyAyaH । romagucCaH 2 prakIrRakam 3 । iti hemacandraH ॥ (yaTA, kumAre । 1 । 13 । “lANgUlavikzepavisarpiSoBEritastataScandramarIcigOrEH । yasyArTayuktaM girirAjaSabdaM kurvvanti bAlavyajanEScamaryyaH ॥”) bAlakasya vyajanaYca ॥ “bAlavyajanamojasyaM makzikAdIn vyapohati .” iti dravyaguRaH ॥
v: na॰ bAlA eva vyajanam । cAmare hemaca॰ । ‘kurvanti bAlavyajanEScamaryyaH’ iti kumAraH ।

v: na॰ bAlasya yajYopavItamiva kAyati kE--ka । uraskawe (vukavACAqi) trikA॰ ।
m: बाल—यज्ञोपवीतक n. the sacred thread worn across the breast, L.
a sort of substitute for the s˚ th˚ worn by children (?), W. (cf. बालोपवीत).
बाल्बज mf(ई)n. (fr. बल्बज) made of the grass Eleusine Indica, ŚBr.; MBh. (B. बाल्वज).
बाल्बजभारिक mfn. (fr. बल्बज + भार) laden or burdened with Balbaja grass g. वंशादि.
बाल्बजिक mfn. bearing Balbaja grass, ib. (cf. बल्बजिक).
बालेश्वर m. N. of an author, Cat.
बालेन्दु m. the new or waxing moon, Kum.
बालेयार्धिक mfn. Pāt.

s: puM, (balaye upakaraRAya sADuH । bali + “CadirupaGivalerQaY .” 5 । 1 । 13 । iti QaY .) rAsaBaH । ityamaraH । 2 । 9 । 77 ॥ (yaTA, mArkaRqeye । 50 । 85 । “ekacCAgaM dbibAleyaM trigavaM paYcamAhizam । zaqaSvaM saptamAtaNgaM gfhaM yakzASu Sozaya ॥” baleH svanAmaKyAtasya dEtyasyApatyaM pumAn । bali + QaY .) dEtyaviSezaH । iti DaraRiH ॥ (baliH virocanaputtrastasya bARajyezWaM puttraSataM jAtam te ca bAleyanAmnA viKyAtAH । yaduktamagnipurARe । “virocanasya puttrastu balirekaH pratApavAn । baleH puttraSataM jajYe rAjAnaH sarvva eva te ॥ tezAM praDAnAScatvAro vikrAntAH sumahAvalAH । sahasrabAhurjyezWaSca kanya dbe ca baleH SuBe ॥ baleH puttrAstu pOtrASca SataSo'Ta sahamaSaH । bAleyo nAma viKyAto gaRo vikrAntapOruzaH ॥” janamejayavaMSodBavasya sutapaso rAjYaH puttro balistasya paYca puttrASca bAleyAH । yaTA, haribaMSe । 31 । 30 -- 33 । “Penasya sutapA jajYe jajYe sutapaso baliH । jAto mAnuzayonO tu sa rAjA kAYcanezuDiH ॥ mahAyogI sa tu balirbaBUva nfpatiH purA । puttrAnutpAdayAmAsa paYca vaMSakarAn Buvi ॥ aNgaH praTamato jajYe vaNgaH suhmastaTEva ca । puRqraH kaliNgaSca taTA bAleyaM kzattramucyate ॥ bAleyA brAhmaRAScEva tasya vaMSakarA Buvi । balestu brahmaRA dattA varAH prItena BArata ! ॥”) aNgAravallarI । iti viSvaH ॥ cARakyamUlakam । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥

tri, (bAlAya hitaH । bAla + QaY .) mfduH । bAlahitaH । iti medinI ॥ (balaye upahArAya hitaH । bali + CadirupaDibalerQaY .” 5 । 1 । 13 । iti QaY । taRqulaH ॥ yaTA, sidDAntakOmudyAm । “bAleyAstaRqulAH ॥” baliyogyaH । yaTA, raGO । 14 । 77 । “puzpaM PalaYcArttavamAhavantyo bIjaYca bAleyamakfzwarohi । vinodayizyanti navABizaNgAmudAravAco munikanyakAstvAm ॥” vitunnakanAmno vfkzasya tvaci klI । tatparyyAyo yaTA, -- “kuwannawaM dAsapuraM bAleyaM paripelavam । plavagopuragonarddakEvarttImustakAni ca ॥ mustAvat pelavapuwaM SukrABaM syAdvitunnakam ॥” iti BAvaprakASasya pUrvvaKaRqe praTame BAge ॥)
v: pu॰ balerapatyaM, balaye hitaM vA Qak । 1 rAsaBe, amaraH 2 dEtyaBede, DaraRiH 3 aNgaravallaryyAM viSvaH । 4 cARakyamUlake pu॰ 5 bAlahite ca tri॰ medi॰ ।
m: 1. बालेय mfn. fit or proper for children, L.
tender, soft, L. (for 2. See below).
2. बालेय mfn. (fr. बलि) fit for an offering or oblation, Ragh.
descended from Bali, Hariv.
बालेय m. an ass, Var.
a species of Cyperus, Bhpr.
a kind of radish, L. (prob. w.r. for शालेय)
patr. fr. बलि, KātyŚr.
(pl.), VP.
N. of a Daitya, L.
a: बालेय — a. (यी f.) [बलये हितं ढक्] 1 Fit for an offering. --2 Tender, soft. --3 Descended from Bali. --यः An ass.

v: pu॰ balaye hitaM Qak karma॰ (vAmanahAwi) SAkaBede amaraH ।
m: बालेय—शाक m. a kind of vegetable (= अङ्गार-वल्ली), L.

k.v: अङ्गारवल्ली बालेयशाकबर्बरवर्धकाः। मञ्जिष्टा विकसा जिङ्गी समङ्गा कालमेषिका॥

s: puM, (bAlAnAM izwaH priyaH .) vadaraH । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ bAlakABilazite, tri ॥

m: बालेष्ट m. ‘liked by children’, a jujube tree, L.

v: tri॰ balhO jAtam Pak । 1 balhideSodBave hiNguni na॰ ।
m: बाल्हायन mf(ई)n., fr. बाल्हि, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 99; Pat.
बाल्हीश्वर m. pl. N. of a dynasty, VP.

बाल्हीक, बाह्लीक or वाह्लीक, m. (pl.) N. of a people, MBh.; R. &c.; a prince of the Bālhīkas, MBh.; N. of a son of Janam-ejaya, ib.; of a son of Pratīpa, ib.; Pur.; of the father of Rohiṇī (wife of Vasu-deva), Hariv.; of a Gandharva, L.; of a poet, Cat.; (ई), f. a princess or any woman of the Bālhikas (also N. of माद्री, q.v.), MBh.; Bālar.; mf(ई)n. belonging to or derived from the Bālhikas, L.; n. = बाल्हिक, L.
बाल्हीक—भाषा f. the language of the Bāhlikas (enumerated among the Prākṛt dialects), Sāh.
बाल्हीकेश m. lord of the Bālhīkas, R.

a: बाल्हकाः, बाल्हिकाः, बाल्हीकाः — (m. pl.) N. of a people. --कः 1 A king of the Bālhikas. --2 A horse of the Balkh breed. --कं 1 Saffron. --2 Asa Fœtida.

v: na॰ balhideSe BavaH bA॰ buY । kuNkume amaraH pAWAntaram ।

m: बाल्हव m. an inhabitant of Balkh (f(ई). ), Bālar.
बाल्हि, बाह्लि or वाह्लि, N. of a country, Balkh, ib.
a: बाल्हिः — N. of a country (Balkh). --Comp. --ज a. bred in the Balkh country, of the Balkh breed.

m: बाल्हि—ज or बाल्हि—जात, mfn. born or bred in Balkh (as a horse), MBh.; R.

m: बाल्हिक or बाह्लिक, m. (pl.) N. of a people, MBh.; a king of the Bālhikas, ib.; Hariv.; Pur.; N. of a son of Pratīpa, Hariv.; (pl.) of a dynasty, BhP.; mfn. of the Balkh breed (as horses), MBh.; R.; n. (w.r. बाल्हक) saffron, L.; Asa Foetida, L.
बाल्हिकेय-मिश्र m. N. of an author, Cat.

s: puM, (bAle keSe jAtaH । bAla + iY .) kapiviSezaH । tatparyyAyaH । EndraH 2 bAlI 3 । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥ (ayameva SrIrAmeRa hataH । asya janmAdikavivftistu bAlin Sabde drazwavyA .)
v: pu॰ bAle keSe jAtaH iY । keSe indraskannaSukrajAte vAnaraBede । bAlaH utpattisTAnatvenAstyasya ini । bAlin tatrArTe trikA॰ । tadutpattikaTA rAmA॰ uttarA॰ 37 sa॰ yaTA “utplutya tasmAt sa hradAdutTitaH plavagaH punaH । taspinneva kzaRe rAma! strItvaM prApa sa vAnaraH । tadrUpamadButaM dfzwvA tyajitO DEryyamAtmanaH । tatastasyAM surendreRa skannaM SiraYci pAtitam । anAsAdyEva tAM nArI sannivfttamaTA Bavat । tataH sA vAnarapatiM jajYe vAnaramISvaram । amoGaretasastasya vAsavasya mahAtmanaH । bAlezu patitaM bIjaM bAlI nAma baBUva ha । BAskareRApi tasyAM vE kandarpavaSavarttinA । bIjaM niziktaM grIvAyAM viDAnamanuvarttatA । grIvAyAM patitaM bIjaM sugrIvaH samajAyata” ।
m: बालि See वालि.
a: बालिः — N. of a celebrated monkeyking; see वालि. --Comp. --हन्, --हंतृ m. an epithet of Rāma.

s: puM, pulastyakanyAyAM sannatyAM kratoH zazwisahasrasaMKyakaputtrA fziviSezAH । yaTA, -- “prItyAM pulastyo BagavAn dattAtrimasfjat pramuH । pUrvvajanmani so'gastyaH smftaH svAyamBuve'ntare ॥ vedabAhuM taTA kanyAM sannatirnAma nAmataH । puttrARAM zazwisAhasraM sannatiH suzuve kratoH ॥ te cordDvaretasaH sarvve bAliKilyA iti smftAH ॥” iti kOrmma 12 aDyAyaH ॥ api ca । “kratoSca sannatirBAryyA bAliKilyAnasUyata । DazwiryAni sahasrARi fzIRAmUrdDvaretasAm ॥” iti mArkaRqeyapurARe rudrasargaH । 52 । 24 ॥ tezAmaNguzWaparimARasya pramARaM yaTA, -- “aTApaSyadfzIn hrasvAnaNguzWodaravarzmaRaH । palASavfntikAmekAM sahitAn vahataH paTi ॥ pralInAn svezvivANgezu nirAhArAMstapoDanAn । kliSyamAnAn mandabalAn gozpade saMplutodake ॥” iti mahABArate । 1 । 31 ॥ bAlaKilyo'pi pAWaH । yaTA, “fgvadAntargatabAlaKilyamekAdaSasUktaM bAlaKilyAH SaMsanti prARA vE bAlaKilyAH । iti caraRavyUhaBAzyam ॥
klI, (bAlAH santi yasya iti bAlI mastakastena Sete yatra । SI + ADAre qa .) upaDAnam । iti SabdamAlA ॥ (brAhmaRAdirAkftigaRaH । iti pARiniH । 5 । 1 । 124 ॥)

tri, (bAqa + in । qasya latvaM । bAliM vfdDiM SyatIti । bAli + So + Ato'nupeti kaH .) SiSuH । (yaTA, BAgavate । 4 । 14 । 23 । “bAliSA vata yUyaM vA aDarmme DarmmamAninaH ॥” bAliSA SiSuvfttaya ityarTaH ॥) mUrKaH । iti medinI । Se, 26 ॥ (yaTA, manuH । 3 । 176 । “apANktyo yAvataH pANktyAn BuYjAnAnanupaSyati । tAvatAM na PalaM tatra dAtA prApnoti bAliSaH ॥” “bAliSo'jYaH .” iti tawwIkA ॥)
v: tri॰ bAqa--in bAqiM vfdDiM Syati So--ka qasya laH । 1 mUrKe, 2 SiSO ca medi॰ “bAliSamAli! SayAnam” udBawaH । bAlAH santyasya ini vAlI mUrdDvA Sete'tra SI-- bA॰ ADAre qa । 3 upaDAne na॰ SabdamA॰ ।
m: 1. बालिश mf(आ)n. young, childish, puerile, ignorant, simple, foolish, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
बालिश m. a fool, simpleton, blockhead, ib.
2. बालिश n. (for 1. See above) = Pers. بالش a pillow, cushion, L.
a: बालिश — a. 1 Childish, puerile, silly. --2 Young. --3 Foolish, ignorant; Ms. 3. 176. --4 Careless. --शः 1 A fool, blockhead. --2 A child, boy. --शं A pillow.

k.v: अज्ञे मूढयथाजातमूर्खवैधेयबालिशाः। कदर्ये कृपणक्षुद्रकिम्पचानमितम्पचाः॥
स्यात्कर्कशः साहसिकः कठोरामसृणावपि। प्रकाशोऽतिप्रसिद्धेऽपि शिशावज्ञे च बालिशः॥

m: बालिश—मति mfn. childish-minded, foolish, MBh.
बालिश—ता f. (Uttarar.) childishness, simplicity, folly.
बालिश—त्व n. (Hariv.) childishness, simplicity, folly.
बालिश्य n. (g. ब्राह्मणादि) childishness, youth, thoughtlessness, folly, Mn.; MBh. &c.
a: बालिश्यं — 1 Youth, boyhood. --2 Childishness, silliness, folly.

v: pu॰ bAliM bAlinaM vA hanti hana--kvip । rAme bAlihantrAdayopyatra pu॰ । tatkaTA rAmA॰ sundarAkARqe dfSyA ।

s: puM, (bAlerbAlino vA bAnararAjasya hantA .) SrIrAmacandraH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (bAlivaDakaTA yaTA, rAmAyaRe । 4 । 16 । 27 -- 36 । “sUryyaputtro mahAvIryyaH sugrIvaH parihIyata । vAlinA Bagnadarpastu sugrIvo mandavikramaH ॥ bAlinaM prati sAmarzo darSayAmAsa rAGavam । vfkzEH saSAKEH SiKarErvajrakowiniBErnaKEH ॥ muzwiBirjAnuBiH padBirbAhuBiSca punaH punaH । tayoryudDamaBUdGoraM vftravAsavayoriva ॥ tO SoRitAktO yuDyetAM vAnarO vanacAriRO । meGAviva mahASabdEstarjamAnO parasparam ॥ hIyamAnamaTApaSyat sugrIvaM vAnareSvaram । prekzamARaM diSaScEva rAGazaH sa muhurmuhuH ॥ tato rAmo mahAtejA ArttaM dfzwvA harISvaram । sa SaraM vIkzate vIro bAlino vaDakANkzayA ॥ tato Danuzi sanDAya SaramASIvizopamam । pUrayAmAsa taccApaM kAlacakramivAntakaH ॥ tasya jyAtalaGozeRa trastAH patraraTeSvarAH । praduddruvurmfgAScEva yugAnta iva mohitAH ॥ muktastu vajranirGozaH pradIptASanisanniBaH । rAGaveRa mahAbARo bAlivakzasi pAtitaH ॥ tatastena mahAtejA vIryyayuktaH kapISvaraH । vegenABihato bAlI nipapAta mahItale ॥) oqradeSAntargatagrAmaviSezaSca ॥

strI, (bAlA eva । bAla + svArTe kan । wAp ata itvam .) bAlA । kanyA । bAlukA । patrakAhalA । karRaBUzaRam । iti medinI । ke, 130 ॥ elA । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ kanyAsvarUpalakzaRe yaTA, -- “kanyA devyA svayaM proktA kanyArUpA tu SUlinI । yAvadakzatayoniH syAttAvaddevI surArihA ॥” iti devIpurARam ॥
a: बालिका — 1 A girl, young woman. --2 The knot of an ear-ring. --3 Small cardamoms. --4 Sand. --5 The rustling of leaves.

m: बालिमन् m. childhood, youth, immaturity g. पृथ्व्-आदि.
a: बालिमन् — m. Childhood, boyhood, youth.

m: बालिन् See वालिन्.
a: बालिन् — m. N. of a monkey; see वालि.
बालिनी — The constellation Aśvini.

s: puM, balmIkasyApatyam । (balmIka + iY .) balmIkapraBavo yasmAt tasmAdbAlmIkirityasO iti brahmavEvarttokteH । balmIkapraBavatvena gORI puttrAdivadgORamasya balmIkApatyatvaM gfhItvEva sADurapatyArTaH । yadvA balmIka iti fziviSezasya saMjYetyAhuH ॥ muniviSezaH । yaTA, -- “tapaHsvADyAyanirataM tapasvI vAgvidAmbaram । nAradaM paripapracCa bAlmIkirmunipuNgavam ॥” iti rAmAyaRapraTamaSlokaH ॥ api ca । tatastadanugrahalabDaM rAmacaritaM sarahasyaM niravaSezaM tatprasAdAdeva samyak vijYAya BUlokavarttinAM caturRAM varRAnAM tApatrayavimocanAya brahmAMSaBUta eva BagavAn prAcetaso bAlmIkiH svakftaSatakowirAmAyaRasAraBUtaM caturziMSatyakzaragAyattryAKyAparabrahmavidyAvilAsa BUtaM rAmAyaRaM caturviMSatisahasraSlokarUpaM kuSalavAByAmagrAhayat । iti tawwIkA ॥ api ca । “nArAyaRAtmakAH sarvve tezAM rAmo'grajo'Bavat । rAvaRAntakaro rAjA raGURAM vaMSavardDanaH ॥ bAlmIkiryasya caritaM cakre BArgavasattamaH ॥”) iti mAtsye 13 aDyAyaH ॥

m: बालोक m. N. of an author, Cat.
बालोपचर˚णीय mfn. relating to it
बालोपचरण n. medical treatment of children (also ˚चार), Cat.
बालोपचर˚णिय n. N. of ch. of wk. ib.
बालोपनिषद् f. N. of an Upaniṣad.

s: klI, (bAlAnAM bAlakAnAM upavItam .) bAlakapariDAnavastram । tatparyyAyaH । paYcAvawam 2 uraskawam 3 । iti hArAvalI । 48 ॥ dvijabAlakAnAM yajYasUtraYca ॥
m: बालोपवीत n. = बाल-यज्ञोपवीतक, a cloth covering the privities, W.

m: बालु बालुक &c. See वालु &c.
a: बालुः, बालुकं — A kind of perfume.
